enowx/enowx: Run Claude Code, Codex and 43 other coding agents in parallel, each on its own branch in its own git worktree, on your machine or your own server. Watch, compare and merge them from one window.
YuanZhe-99/Kyokai: A cross-platform Computer Use application that lets people and AI agents interact with the same desktop.
foyoodo/Cove: A native macOS chat client drawn with MyGo's ui package instead of a web view, talking to any OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint.
nggalek-co/titen: A native desktop meeting transcription app for macOS and Windows, built with MyGo native GPU widgets, Go and platform-specific capture helpers. It records system audio and microphone input and turns meetings into text.
hunghg255/mycode: A small, fast code editor written in Go. It draws a native UI on the GPU with MyGo — no web view, no Electron.
congthien2003/dbl: SBDb brings connection management, database exploration, table inspection and data editing into one focused desktop workspace. Built with Go and MyGo Native UI, it follows a simple, keyboard-friendly workflow.
fzn0x/mixmusic: Spotify and YouTube Music in one player: one search, one queue, mixed playlists, synced lyrics and an equalizer with community themes, for macOS, Windows and Linux.
fazi-gondal/video-downloader-mygo: Native desktop video downloader built with Go, MyGo, yt-dlp and FFmpeg. It analyzes videos and playlists, lets you choose quality, audio, subtitles and container, manages a download queue, converts local media and keeps a download history.
owocc/bowerbird: A cross-platform desktop digital asset manager built with MyGo (Go) in webview mode and React 19, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS v4 — the desktop shell migrated from Electron to MyGo.
0froq/snip: A minimal macOS clipboard manager prototype built with MyGo native UI. Each new plain-text copy spawns a small floating card, and global shortcuts show or hide the history.
sugarbearr/gogo-explorer: A from-scratch, opinionated take on the Windows Task Manager. There is no sidebar and no tab bar: the process table is the main screen, and selecting a row opens a detail panel for that process.
huynhkinhao1910/scan-image: Finder and Spotlight are slow on SMB network drives because every search asks the server again. Scan Image walks the tree once, keeps the index in RAM and on disk, then only rescans what changed.
aouyitanaka/Fsearch-Mygo-GUI: A native desktop front end for fsearch, the fast file-search utility.
preceeder/gui-redis: A desktop GUI for redis-cli on macOS and Windows.
shenjing023/KLineChart-go: KLineChart for Go — candlestick charts rendered in a MyGo native window.
myoula/ape-player: An Emby media player built for Omarchy.
rksvc/sav: A game save manager for backing up, restoring and organizing local saves.
chemark/xingshu-music: Xingshu Music — a personal NetEase Cloud Music client for macOS, built on mygo-cloudmusic.
Simqiqi/simqiqi-music: A third-party NetEase Cloud Music desktop client with a native Go UI and no WebView: liquid glass, vinyl mode, per-syllable lyrics and smart transitions, built on mygo-cloudmusic.
echoVic/little-reef: Little Reef — grow a coral reef with your focus time, with a desktop widget, a visitor encyclopedia and offline background audio.
Qsnh/lanscout: See which devices are on your LAN, which IP each one holds and which addresses are still free.
bitoolkit/biternet-go: A Beijing Institute of Technology campus-network client written in Go and MyGo.
li-yifei/lom-dx2metal: An offline Unity 2020.3 D3D11-to-Metal shader converter that lets the official macOS ARM64 player run Windows build data for Legend of Mortal.
ca-x/lark: Lark — a beautiful web-based music player.
logseq/lui: A cross-platform UI for OCaml, built on a MyGo fork.
egoist/lorca: Imagine Telegram but single-user, with agents and end-to-end encryption — an alternative to Grok bot, Muse and Dots.
hehehai/AudioSmith: Speech, voices, stories, audiobooks, dubbing and transcription, made on your Mac. Free and open source.
hyoban/peek: A native Git diff viewer: a Changes mode stacking diffs with the history, and a Files mode reading any file as the commit has it. Changed files are grouped into code, tests, docs and generated files and marked viewed, with syntax-highlighted diffs in unified or side-by-side layout, step-through of every change, copyable line references and GitHub links, comments from the gutter that can be copied as an agent prompt, and Codex review findings shown under the lines they concern. Several repositories in one window, plus branch switching and PR checkout via the GitHub CLI.
sorrycc/Mayoi: A small, fast code editor written in Go, with a native GPU-drawn UI — no webview, no Electron.
michaelmjhhhh/Chaos: A macOS utility for handling screenshots.
si-mods/MyVNC: A pure-Go VNC viewer for Windows built with MyGo, ported from TigerVNC.
cainiao524/hd2-font-maker-go: A Windows tool that generates Helldivers 2 font-replacement mods from your own fonts, with 14 UI languages.
welllog/otool: A fast, lightweight pure-Go toolbox for development and daily operations, rendered natively on the GPU with no WebView and no cgo — about 15 MB of memory at rest.
VaalaCat/mygo-kit: A native Go component library built on MyGo and styled after Zed: continuous panels, compact toolbars, small corner radii and One Light / One Dark themes.
hoanglong2311/mcpgw: A local MCP gateway for macOS: declare each stdio MCP server once and a launchd daemon exposes it as a Streamable HTTP endpoint that every MCP client can share.
qmaru/wgm: A native WireGuard manager built with Go and MyGo's native UI.
Seevil/webtools: SiteClone — a Windows desktop tool that downloads a site's static pages and assets, rewrites references to local paths and saves the result for offline viewing.
tbdsux/keydepot: A desktop vault that keeps SSH, PGP and other private keys encrypted with AES-256-GCM on your own machine, grouped by project and one copy away.
Clearzero22/pi-web-desktop: A MyGo shell for pi-web that runs the web UI against an isolated Node runtime.
hoanglong2311/AI-limit: A macOS menu-bar app for viewing AI subscription usage.
ijry/YoYoCode: A native Go take on codeg: a collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Grok Build and others.
zrcoder/ndor: Draw with code, for kids and coders.
Viking602/YoloMCL: YoloMCL — a cross-platform Minecraft: Java Edition launcher written in Go.
firede/limu: A diagram layout engine in Go.
addidotlol/mycn: shadcn/ui-style components for MyGo native UI, themed by calling mycn.Use each frame.
oneo-me/neohm: A macOS menu-bar app for controlling Home Assistant devices, with full air-conditioner controls. Built in Go with MyGo and Onevra.
rayorole/orole-os-desktop: Orole OS — a personal operating environment for Windows, built with MyGo, a Go daemon and React.
ca-x/nvflasher: A MyGo desktop app for flashing and provisioning NVIDIA Jetson devices, with a Linux flashing backend.
